title: astracantha kuhistana
intro: Astracantha kuhistana, commonly known as the Kuhistan thorny pea, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Astracantha kuhistana include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various gastrointestinal disorders. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
